ambush.oromist-npc.mining: Something moves in the tunnels... orcs!
command.oromist-npc.ambush_failed: Could not find a valid place for the ambush.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.0: Fresh meat. So you are %1$s... soon you will be nobody.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.1: I smell a human. And it smells of fear.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.2: Your head will look good on my spike, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.4: Remember my name. It'll be the last thing you hear.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.0: The wound you gave me in %3$s still hurts, %1$s. Today I pay it back.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.1: %2$s days ago you cut me open. Now it's my turn.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.2: This scar has your name on it, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.0: Yes, I ran in %3$s. A smart orc knows when to retreat... and when to return.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.1: Last time I escaped. This time there's nothing to run from.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.2: Did you laugh when I ran, %1$s? Laugh now.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.0: Look who's back! Last time you ran away in %3$s, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.1: Running again, coward? You've done it %4$s times already.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.2: Your legs were faster than your sword %2$s days ago.
You killed my brothers in %3$s. I've come to collect.
I saw you slaughter my kin, %1$s. I don't forget.
Every orc you killed screams in my head. Today they'll be quiet.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.0: We meet again, %1$s. I always find you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.1: You can't hide from me. Never.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.0: You again? I killed you in %3$s %2$s days ago, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.1: I've tasted your blood once. I want more.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.2: The worm I killed in %3$s came crawling back!
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.3: Your death made me a captain. What will you give me this time?
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player_again: I've killed you %4$s times, %1$s. Don't you learn?
I lost count... oh wait: %4$s. Let's go for another!
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.0: Thought you killed me in %3$s? Look at this scar, %1$s!
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.1: Death didn't want me. I came back for you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.2: You left me for dead %2$s days ago. Mistake.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.3: Surprise, %1$s! Orcs don't die that easily.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death_agai: You've 'killed' me %4$s times. I'm still here.
Going to try killing me again? You know how this ends.
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.0: I'm a captain now, thanks to you!
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.2: The army will know my name.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.0: Nice house, %1$s. It'll look better on fire.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.1: We followed you to your burrow.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.1: Down here nobody will hear you scream.
